PainPoints.title: The Hidden Cost of SaaS Workflow Tools

items.title: Zapier bills scale with success
items.desc: Every task costs. As your business grows, so does your Zapier bill — €200, €500, €1,000+ per month. You are paying a tax on your own growth.

items.title: Your data lives on someone else's server
items.desc: Customer data, financial records, internal processes — all flowing through third-party cloud infrastructure. For GDPR-sensitive businesses, this is a compliance risk.

items.title: Rate limits block critical workflows
items.desc: When you need to process 10,000 records and Zapier caps you at 2,000 tasks per month, your automation breaks exactly when you need it most.

items.title: Complex logic requires workarounds
items.desc: Conditional branching, loops, error handling — things that should be simple become convoluted multi-Zap chains. Debugging is a nightmare.

items.title: Missing integrations force manual steps
items.desc: Your internal tool, niche SaaS, or custom API has no Zapier integration. So someone on your team manually bridges the gap every day.

items.title: No visibility into workflow performance
items.desc: When a Zap fails silently, you do not know until a customer complains. No centralized monitoring, no alerting, no audit trail.

Solutions.title: What We Build With n8n
Solutions.subtitle: We are not a no-code agency. We engineer production-grade workflow systems that run on your infrastructure, scale with your business, and are fully documented.

items.title: Zapier & Make to n8n Migration
items.desc: We audit your existing automations, map every trigger and action, and rebuild them in n8n with improved error handling, logging, and performance. Zero downtime migration.
items.result: 60–80% cost reduction. Full data sovereignty.

items.title: Custom Workflow Architecture
items.desc: We design and build complex multi-step workflows with conditional logic, parallel execution, error recovery, and webhook endpoints. Built for reliability, not just functionality.
items.result: Workflows that scale with your business, not break under load.

items.title: Self-Hosted n8n Setup & Optimization
items.desc: We deploy n8n on your infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud VPS), configure queue mode for high-volume processing, set up backups, and optimize for performance.
items.result: Unlimited tasks. No rate limits. Full control.

items.title: Custom API Integrations
items.desc: n8n's HTTP node and custom code blocks let us connect to any API — your internal tools, niche SaaS platforms, or legacy systems. No integration is off-limits.
items.result: Every system connected. No manual bridging.

items.title: Workflow Monitoring & Alerting
items.desc: We set up execution logging, error notifications (Slack, email, webhook), and dashboard monitoring. You know immediately when something fails — before your customers do.
items.result: Zero silent failures. Full operational visibility.

items.title: GDPR-Compliant Data Pipelines
items.desc: Self-hosted n8n means your data never leaves your infrastructure. We build with data minimization, encryption, and audit logging from day one.
items.result: AVG/GDPR compliance by design, not as an afterthought.

MigrationSteps.title: Our Migration Process
MigrationSteps.subtitle: From audit to live — a structured, zero-downtime migration.

steps.title: Workflow Audit & Documentation
steps.desc: We map every existing Zap or Make scenario: triggers, actions, data flow, error handling, and dependencies. You get a complete inventory of your automation stack.

steps.title: n8n Architecture Design
steps.desc: We design the target n8n architecture: workflow structure, credential management, execution mode, and infrastructure requirements. Reviewed with your team before build.

steps.title: Parallel Build & Testing
steps.desc: We rebuild workflows in n8n alongside your existing Zaps. Both run in parallel so we validate output accuracy before switching. No disruption to your operations.

steps.title: Cutover & Monitoring
steps.desc: Once validated, we switch traffic to n8n workflows. We monitor closely for 2 weeks, fix any edge cases, and provide full documentation and handover.

WhyN8n.title: Why n8n Over Zapier or Make

points.title: Unlimited executions, flat pricing
points.desc: Self-hosted n8n costs a fraction of Zapier at scale. No per-task fees, no tier upgrades as you grow. Your workflow volume is not a billing problem.

points.title: Full data control and GDPR compliance
points.desc: Data stays on your infrastructure. No third-party processing, no data residency questions. Critical for Dutch businesses handling sensitive customer information.

points.title: Complex logic without workarounds
points.desc: Native support for loops, conditionals, error handling, merge nodes, and custom JavaScript. Build what you actually need — not what the platform allows.

points.title: Open source and future-proof
points.desc: n8n is open source (fair-code). Your workflows are JSON files — version-controllable, portable, and not locked to a proprietary platform. You own everything.

FAQ.title: Common Questions
FAQ.subtitle: What businesses ask before migrating to n8n.

questions.q: Can you migrate all our Zaps to n8n without downtime?
questions.a: Yes. We run n8n workflows in parallel with your existing Zaps during testing. Once validated, we switch traffic in a controlled cutover. Your operations continue uninterrupted.

questions.q: How much does self-hosted n8n cost compared to Zapier?
questions.a: For most businesses, self-hosted n8n costs 60–80% less than Zapier at equivalent task volumes. A €5–10/month VPS can handle tens of thousands of executions. We provide a cost comparison during the audit.

questions.q: Do we need technical staff to manage n8n?
questions.a: No. We handle the setup, configuration, and documentation. The n8n UI is visual and intuitive — similar to Zapier. We provide training and ongoing support. You do not need a dedicated engineer.

questions.q: What if a workflow we need has no n8n integration?
questions.a: n8n's HTTP node and custom code blocks let us connect to any API. If it has a REST or GraphQL API, we can integrate it. We have built custom connectors for dozens of niche platforms.

questions.q: How long does a typical migration take?
questions.a: A standard migration (10–30 workflows) takes 3–5 weeks from audit to cutover. Larger migrations or complex custom integrations may take 6–8 weeks. We scope the timeline during the audit.

items.q: What does an AI consulting engagement cost?
items.a: Scope varies significantly by company, project maturity, systems, data access and integration complexity, so we do not publish fixed project rates. AI Strategy Sprints typically range from €2,500–€5,000. Implementation Projects start at €9,500 and scale with integration complexity. Ongoing Partner engagements start from €5,500/month and are scoped around the amount of engineering capacity required. We provide a detailed estimate after the initial fit check or audit — before you commit to anything.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: AI Strategy Sprint: 1–2 weeks. Implementation Projects: 4–8 weeks from scoping to deployment, depending on how many systems are involved and their integration complexity. We set realistic timelines at scoping and don't revise them unless requirements change materially.

items.q: What do you need from us to get started?
items.a: A clear description of the problem you want to solve and access to the relevant systems — CRM credentials, API documentation, or similar. We don't require weeks of onboarding. A focused discovery call is usually enough to scope accurately.

items.q: How do you handle our data and privacy?
items.a: GDPR compliance is a baseline, not an option. We define data handling at scoping: what data flows through the system, where it's stored, and who has access. For sensitive industries or regulated data, we can work with on-premise or private cloud deployments.

items.q: Does the AI integrate with our existing tools?
items.a: Yes — integration with your existing stack is a core requirement, not a feature. We have experience integrating with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, WhatsApp Business API, Slack, common ERPs, and custom APIs. If you use it, we've likely connected to it or can.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside the Netherlands?
items.a: Yes. We're based in Leiden but work with clients across Europe and internationally. All engagements can run fully remotely.

items.q: What happens after deployment?
items.a: Implementation Projects include 30 days of post-deployment support. Ongoing Partner engagements cover continuous maintenance and development. For completed one-time projects, we provide full documentation and a handover session so your team can operate the system independently.

items.q: Can you build on top of tools we already use, like Make or Zapier?
items.a: Yes. We frequently migrate clients from Zapier or Make to more robust, cost-effective stacks — or extend automations they've already started. We recommend based on your volume, budget, and maintenance capacity, not on what's convenient for us.

items.q: What if we're not sure which AI use case to start with?
items.a: That's exactly what the AI Strategy Sprint is for. We map your operations, rank automation opportunities by ROI, and hand you a prioritized roadmap. You leave with a clear implementation plan — whether you work with us to build it or take it in-house.
